command:
awk -F, 'NR>1 {t[$2]+=$3} END {for (r in t) print r, t[r]}' ~/data/sales.csv | sort -k2 -nr > ~/report.txt
cat ~/report.txt
tar czf ~/archive.tgz -C ~ archive report.txt && rm -r ~/archive && tar tzvf ~/archive.tgz
